entries.zh: 安守本分；守着自己的名分过日子，不越分。
entries.en: to keep to one's own station; to be content with one's lot; to keep one's duty in all things.
entries.notes: 西语栏「guardar los perseveranca en todo」语法残缺，释义依 H/M「安本分」定。

entries.zh: 收敛口舌；少说话、少吃东西（守口、节食）。
entries.en: to keep one's mouth in check: to be sparing in speech and in eating; to fast or abstain.

entries.zh: 留心；用心看顾、时刻在意。
entries.en: to keep one's heart on; to be attentive and watchful.
entries.notes: H 首字「晋」当为「留」之形讹（M 音 liū 可证），故取「留心」义。

entries.zh: 把持留住；把这念想记存下来。
entries.en: to hold fast; to keep (a remembrance) in mind.
entries.notes: H「把占」与西语栏对应不直接，依 M 音 pē-chiàm 与「把持」义推定。

entries.zh: 藏话；把话藏起来不说，保守秘密。
entries.en: to hide one's words; to keep a secret.

entries.zh: 藏起来不让人听见；隐瞒秘事。
entries.en: to keep from being heard; to conceal (a secret).
entries.notes: 「藏聽」搭配罕见，第二字义费解，释义依西语栏与 M 音 quēng-chām 推定。

entries.zh: 把言语藏住不说；守口保密。
entries.en: to keep one's words hidden; to keep a secret.
entries.notes: M 栏末尾「1oy」不可读，H 四字中「聽」义费解，释义依西语栏定。

entries.zh: 潜藏涵养；把事暗藏心底不露。
entries.en: to keep hidden; to conceal and hold in secret.
entries.notes: 「潛養」与「守密」义稍迂，依西语栏与 M 音 chām-iāng 推定。

entries.zh: 含忍；把话咽在肚里，隐忍不言。
entries.en: to hold in; to bear silently; to keep (it) inside.

entries.zh: 小心看管、谨慎保藏（原稿「却智」二字费解）。
entries.en: to keep with care; to guard carefully.
entries.notes: H「却智」组合罕见且与西语义不合，全条释义主要依 source_L 推定。

entries.zh: 收存放置；把东西搁起藏好。
entries.en: to put away; to stow (something) in a place.
entries.notes: H 首字「到」于闽南语不协（M 作 cò），疑为形讹，语义依西语栏与「藏」字定。

entries.zh: 把东西放在固定处，日后好寻。
entries.en: to put (a thing) in a fixed place so as to find it later.
entries.notes: H「定乙物」形义不明、M 前二音 T99，释读依「定定物」（放置有定处）之推想，存疑。

entries.zh: 怀藏；藏在怀里、贴身收着。
entries.en: to hide in one's bosom; to conceal on one's person.

entries.zh: 敛身退避；抽身躲开、避开。
entries.en: to draw oneself back; to withdraw; to get oneself away.
entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:歛/欽]；「敛身」与同栏 guardarse ~ huir 相合，取「歛」。

entries.zh: 把门闩上守夜；守门看更（西语栏残句，所指不明）。
entries.en: to bar the door and keep watch; to watch at the door.
entries.notes: source_L「guardia delos confessiones,atron」不成文，释义仅依 H/M「把閂」定。

entries.zh: 船上的看守人；看船守夜者。
entries.en: guardian or watchman of a ship.
entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:綜/縺]，音 liān 所指不详；西语栏明确，取「船上看守」义。

entries.en: to mount pictures; to back and frame paintings.
